description_en: Invoke the ListGroupIpMappingRules API to query the IP redirection information of authorization rules for an instance group.
description_zh: 调用ListGroupIpMappingRules接口查询实例组授权规则IP重定向信息
kebab_example: aliyun iotcc list-group-ip-mapping-rules --iot-cloud-connector-group-id iotccg-g00epppbi9di9y0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListGroupIpMappingRules

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud connector instance group
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_group_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of authorization rules that require IP redirection. You can specify up to 20 rule IDs
parameters.help_zh: 需要进行IP重定向的授权规则的ID。最多支持20个授权规则ID
parameters.name: ip_mapping_rule_ids

parameters.help_en: The target IP addresses for redirection. A maximum of 20 IP addresses is supported
parameters.help_zh: 重定向的目标IP地址。最多支持20个目标IP地址
parameters.name: destination_ips

parameters.help_en: The status of IP redirection for authorization rules. You can specify up to 20 statuses
parameters.help_zh: 授权规则IP重定向的状态。最多支持20个授权规则IP重定向的状态
parameters.name: ip_mapping_rule_statuses

parameters.help_en: The names of authorization rules that require IP redirection. A maximum of 20 authorization rule names is supported
parameters.help_zh: 需要进行IP重定向的授权规则名称。最多支持20个授权规则名称
parameters.name: ip_mapping_rule_names

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether a token for the next query exists. Valid values:
If NextToken is empty, there is no subsequent query.
If NextToken has a return value, this value represents the token to start the next query
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries returned per page when queries are performed in batches. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值为20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the instance group.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html API to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
实例组所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The IP addresses that require redirection. You can specify up to 20 IP addresses
parameters.help_zh: 需要进行重定向的IP地址。最多支持20个重定向的IP地址
parameters.name: mapping_ips

IpMappingRuleStatus.description_en:
Status of the authorization rule IP redirection. Valid values:

Creating: Being created.
Created: Creation completed.
Updating: Being updated.
Associating: IP binding in progress.
Dissociating: IP unbinding in progress.
Deleting: Being deleted.
Deleted: Deleted.
IpMappingRuleStatus.description_zh:
授权规则IP重定向的状态。取值：

Creating：创建中。
Created：创建完成。
Updating：更新中。
Associating：IP绑定中。
Dissociating：IP解绑中。
Deleting：删除中。
Deleted：已删除
